views.name: Step 1
views.caption: Place A7 on the left two tabs of A6.

views.name: Step 1c
views.caption: Place A7 on the left two tabs of A6.

views.name: Step 2
views.caption: Push A9 into the cross-shaped slot next to A7.

views.name: Step 2c
views.caption: Push A9 into the cross-shaped slot next to A7.

views.name: Step 3
views.caption: Attach A7 to A9 using a 16mm screw through the center hole in A7.

views.name: Step 3c
views.caption: Attach A7 to A9 using a 16mm screw through the center hole in A7.

views.name: Step 4
views.caption: Place A8 on the other two tabs of A6, with the slot shaped like a servo horn at the bottom.

views.name: Step 4c
views.caption: Place A8 on the other two tabs of A6, with the slot shaped like a servo horn at the bottom.

views.name: Step 5
views.caption: Push A9 into the cross-shaped slot next to A8.

views.name: Step 5c
views.caption: Push A9 into the cross-shaped slot next to A8.

views.name: Step 6
views.caption: Attach A8 to A9 using a 16mm screw through the center hole in A8.

views.name: Step 6c
views.caption: Attach A8 to A9 using a 16mm screw through the center hole in A8.

views.name: Step 7
views.caption: Align the bottom hole in A7 with the outer edge of the hole in R2.

views.name: Step 7c
views.caption: Align the bottom hole in A7 with the outer edge of the hole in R2.

views.name: Step 8
views.caption: Attach A7 to R2 using a 6mm screw.

views.name: Step 8c
views.caption: Attach A7 to R2 using a 6mm screw.

views.name: Step 9
views.caption: Place A2 on A1, aligning the screw holes.

views.name: Step 9c
views.caption: Place A2 on A1, aligning the screw holes.

views.name: Step 10
views.caption: Place A3 on A2, aligning the screw holes.

views.name: Step 10c
views.caption: Place A3 on A2, aligning the screw holes.

views.name: Step 11
views.caption: Attach A1, A2, and A3 using a 10mm screw through the center hole.

views.name: Step 11c
views.caption: Attach A1, A2, and A3 using a 10mm screw through the center hole.

views.name: Step 12
views.caption: Slide the slotted end of A1 - A3 down between R5 and A7. Fit the slot over the head of the screw connecting A7 to R2. Then, push A1 - A3 toward the joysticks.

views.name: Step 12c
views.caption: Slide the slotted end of A1 - A3 down between R5 and A7. Fit the slot over the head of the screw connecting A7 to R2. Then, push A1 - A3 toward the joysticks.

views.name: Step 13
views.caption: Tilt the Elbow Servo (Black Dot) to guide its servo horn through R5. Then, push the servo into place so the horn fits into the slot in A2 and A3.

views.name: Step 13c
views.caption: Tilt the Elbow Servo (Black Dot) to guide its servo horn through R5. Then, push the servo into place so the horn fits into the slot in A2 and A3.

views.name: Step 14
views.caption: Thread the Elbow Servo's wires through R8, then push R8 against the servo. Align the holes in R8 with the holes in R5.

views.name: Step 14c
views.caption: Thread the Elbow Servo's wires through R8, then push R8 against the servo. Align the holes in R8 with the holes in R5.

views.name: Step 15
views.caption: Attach R8 to R5 using a 10mm screw in the top hole.

views.name: Step 15c
views.caption: Attach R8 to R5 using a 10mm screw in the top hole.

views.name: Step 16
views.caption: Attach R8 to R5 using a 10mm screw in the bottom hole.

views.name: Step 16c
views.caption: Attach R8 to R5 using a 10mm screw in the bottom hole.

views.name: Step 17
views.caption: Place the Elbow Servo's wires into the hook-shaped slot in R5.

views.name: Step 17c
views.caption: Place the Elbow Servo's wires into the hook-shaped slot in R5.

views.name: Step 18
views.caption: Place A5 on A4, aligning the right hole in A5 with the left hole in A4.

views.name: Step 18c
views.caption: Place A5 on A4, aligning the right hole in A5 with the left hole in A4.

views.name: Step 19
views.caption: Attach A5 to A4 using a 6mm screw.

views.name: Step 19c
views.caption: Attach A5 to A4 using a 6mm screw.

views.name: Step 20
views.caption: Place A4 against A1, aligning their right holes. Then, place A5 on A7, aligning the middle hole in A5 with the left hole in A7.

views.name: Step 20c
views.caption: Place A4 against A1, aligning their right holes. Then, place A5 on A7, aligning the middle hole in A5 with the left hole in A7.

views.name: Step 21
views.caption: Attach A1 - A3 to A4 using a 10mm screw.

views.name: Step 21c
views.caption: Attach A1 - A3 to A4 using a 10mm screw.

views.name: Step 22
views.caption: Attach A5 to A7 using a 6mm screw.

views.name: Step 22c
views.caption: Attach A5 to A7 using a 6mm screw.

views.name: Step 23
views.caption: Tilt the Shoulder Servo (White Dot) to guide its servo horn through R6, until the horn sits in the slot in A8.

views.name: Step 23c
views.caption: Tilt the Shoulder Servo (White Dot) to guide its servo horn through R6, until the horn sits in the slot in A8.

views.name: Step 24
views.caption: Thread the Shoulder Servo's wires through R7, then push R7 against the servo. Align the holes in R7 with the holes in R6.

views.name: Step 24c
views.caption: Thread the Shoulder Servo's wires through R7, then push R7 against the servo. Align the holes in R7 with the holes in R6.

views.name: Step 25
views.caption: Attach R7 to R6 using a 10mm screw in the top hole.

views.name: Step 25c
views.caption: Attach R7 to R6 using a 10mm screw in the top hole.

views.name: Step 26
views.caption: Attach R7 to R6 using a 10mm screw in the bottom hole.

views.name: Step 26c
views.caption: Attach R7 to R6 using a 10mm screw in the bottom hole.

views.name: Step 27
views.caption: Place the Shoulder Servo's wires into the hook-shaped slot in R6.

views.name: Step 27c
views.caption: Place the Shoulder Servo's wires into the hook-shaped slot in R6.

views.name: Step 28
views.caption: Place A11 on A10, aligning the right hole in A11 with the left hole in A10.

views.name: Step 28c
views.caption: Place A11 on A10, aligning the right hole in A11 with the left hole in A10.

views.name: Step 29
views.caption: Attach A11 to A10 using a 6mm screw.

views.name: Step 29c
views.caption: Attach A11 to A10 using a 6mm screw.

views.name: Step 30
views.caption: Place A12 on A10, aligning the left hole in A12 with the top right hole in A10.

views.name: Step 30c
views.caption: Place A12 on A10, aligning the left hole in A12 with the top right hole in A10.

views.name: Step 31
views.caption: Attach A12 to A10 using a 6mm screw.

views.name: Step 31c
views.caption: Attach A12 to A10 using a 6mm screw.

views.name: Step 32
views.caption: Place A11 against the inside of R6. Place A10 on A8.

views.name: Step 32c
views.caption: Place A11 against the inside of R6. Place A10 on A8.

views.name: Step 33
views.caption: Attach R6 to A11 using a 6mm screw.

views.name: Step 33c
views.caption: Attach R6 to A11 using a 6mm screw.

views.name: Step 34
views.caption: Place A13 on A10, aligning the left hole in A13 with the bottom right hole in A10.

views.name: Step 34c
views.caption: Place A13 on A10, aligning the left hole in A13 with the bottom right hole in A10.

views.name: Step 35
views.caption: Attach A13 to A10 using a 10mm screw.

views.name: Step 35c
views.caption: Attach A13 to A10 using a 10mm screw.

views.name: Step 36
views.caption: Gently swing the wooden pieces back and forth where they connect. Check that they move freely and the screws are not too tight.

views.name: Step 37
views.caption: Push the Claw Servo (Blue Dot) down through C3, wires first. Keep the wires at the notched end of the opening.

views.name: Step 37c
views.caption: Push the Claw Servo (Blue Dot) down through C3, wires first. Keep the wires at the notched end of the opening.

views.name: Step 38
views.caption: Thread the Claw Servo's wires through the hole at the top of C3.

views.name: Step 38c
views.caption: Thread the Claw Servo's wires through the hole at the top of C3.

views.name: Step 39
views.caption: Push the tab of C1 through the slot at the top right of C3.

views.name: Step 39c
views.caption: Push the tab of C1 through the slot at the top right of C3.

views.name: Step 40
views.caption: Push the tab of C2 through the slot at the top left of C3.

views.name: Step 40c
views.caption: Push the tab of C2 through the slot at the top left of C3.

views.name: Step 41
views.caption: Place C4 down into the slot in C3, next to C2. Then, slide C4 toward the top of C3.

views.name: Step 41c
views.caption: Place C4 down into the slot in C3, next to C2. Then, slide C4 toward the top of C3.

views.name: Step 42
views.caption: Place C5 down into the slot in C3, next to C1. Then, slide C5 toward the top of C3.

views.name: Step 42c
views.caption: Place C5 down into the slot in C3, next to C1. Then, slide C5 toward the top of C3.

views.name: Step 43
views.caption: Place C6 on the latches of C1 and C2, fitting the servo horn into the round cutout in C6.

views.name: Step 43c
views.caption: Place C6 on the latches of C1 and C2, fitting the servo horn into the round cutout in C6.

views.name: Step 44
views.caption: Attach C6 to C3 using a 16mm screw in the top hole.

views.name: Step 44c
views.caption: Attach C6 to C3 using a 16mm screw in the top hole.

views.name: Step 45
views.caption: Attach C6 to C3 using a 16mm screw in the bottom hole.

views.name: Step 45c
views.caption: Attach C6 to C3 using a 16mm screw in the bottom hole.

views.name: Step 46
views.caption: Place C7 on the servo horn.
views.caution: If the servo horn is not lined up, you may need to adjust it so that it fits in the C7 slot.

views.name: Step 46c
views.caption: Place C7 on the servo horn.
views.caution: If the servo horn is not lined up, you may need to adjust it so that it fits in the C7 slot.

views.name: Step 47
views.caption: Place C9 on the latches of C1 and C2.

views.name: Step 47c
views.caption: Place C9 on the latches of C1 and C2.

views.name: Step 48
views.caption: Slide C8 between C6 and C9 until the teeth on C8 fit into the teeth on C7.

views.name: Step 48c

inset.alt: Close-up of the claw with C9 left out: the teeth of C7 and C8 mesh together.
inset.caption: Seen without C9

views.caption: Slide C8 between C6 and C9 until the teeth on C8 fit into the teeth on C7.

views.name: Step 49
views.caption: Attach C6 to C9 using a 10mm screw.

views.name: Step 49c
views.caption: Attach C6 to C9 using a 10mm screw.

views.name: Step 50
views.caption: Slide the claw between A5 on one side and A12 and A13 on the other, with the servo facing up. Place A5 on C2, aligning the holes. Then, align A12 with the top hole in C1 and A13 with the bottom hole in C1.

views.name: Step 50c
views.caption: Slide the claw between A5 on one side and A12 and A13 on the other, with the servo facing up. Place A5 on C2, aligning the holes. Then, align A12 with the top hole in C1 and A13 with the bottom hole in C1.

views.name: Step 51
views.caption: Attach A12 to C1 using a 6mm screw.

views.name: Step 51c
views.caption: Attach A12 to C1 using a 6mm screw.

views.name: Step 52
views.caption: Attach A13 to C1 using a 6mm screw.

views.name: Step 52c
views.caption: Attach A13 to C1 using a 6mm screw.

views.name: Step 53
views.caption: Attach A5 to C2 using a 6mm screw.

views.name: Step 53c
views.caption: Attach A5 to C2 using a 6mm screw.

views.name: Step 54
views.caption: Thread the Claw Servo's wires through the top square hole in A6.

views.name: Step 54c
views.caption: Thread the Claw Servo's wires through the top square hole in A6.

views.name: Step 55
views.caption: Thread the Claw Servo's wires through the bottom square hole in A6.

views.name: Step 55c
views.caption: Thread the Claw Servo's wires through the bottom square hole in A6.

views.name: Step 56
views.caption: Connect the Servo Extension Wire to the Claw Servo's wires.
views.caution: Match the wire colors: brown to brown, red to red, and orange to orange.

views.name: Step 56c
views.caption: Connect the Servo Extension Wire to the Claw Servo's wires.
views.caution: Match the wire colors: brown to brown, red to red, and orange to orange.

views.name: Step 57
views.caption: Place the Servo Extension Wire into the hook-shaped slot in R4.

views.name: Step 57c
views.caption: Place the Servo Extension Wire into the hook-shaped slot in R4.

views.name: Step 58
views.caption: Reconnect the Elbow Servo (Black Dot) to Row 6. Match the wires: brown to G, red to V, and orange to S.

views.name: Step 58c
views.caption: Reconnect the Elbow Servo (Black Dot) to Row 6. Match the wires: brown to G, red to V, and orange to S.

views.name: Step 59
views.caption: Reconnect the Shoulder Servo (White Dot) to Row 9. Match the wires: brown to G, red to V, and orange to S.

views.name: Step 59c
views.caption: Reconnect the Shoulder Servo (White Dot) to Row 9. Match the wires: brown to G, red to V, and orange to S.

views.name: Step 60
views.caption: Connect the Servo Extension Wire to Row 10. Match the wires: brown to G, red to V, and orange to S.

views.name: Step 60c
views.caption: Connect the Servo Extension Wire to Row 10. Match the wires: brown to G, red to V, and orange to S.

views.name: Step 61
views.caption: Connect the USB Cable to the Nano Board.

views.name: Step 61c
views.caption: Connect the USB Cable to the Nano Board.

views.name: Step 62
views.caption: Place the top of T2 into one of the slots in T1.

views.name: Step 62c
views.caption: Place the top of T2 into one of the slots in T1.

views.name: Step 63
views.caption: Slide the second T2 onto the first T2, fitting their slots together.

views.name: Step 63c
views.caption: Slide the second T2 onto the first T2, fitting their slots together.

views.name: Step 64
views.caption: Place the second T1 on the tops of both T2 pieces.

views.name: Step 64c
views.caption: Place the second T1 on the tops of both T2 pieces.
